title: early kill (ROADMAP P10): VAL checkpoints at 25 / 50 / 75 % of the E240 fine-tunes predict the final order of j1rc and j1eq on lanes found

a.recipe: j1rc 50 % checkpoints of the four E240 runs (seeds 0-3; evaluate.py names e24_j1rc_s<k>_p50, fork_prune 0.4, VAL 873); 25 % and 75 % on VAL250 with the same assembly
a.note: needs the new flag p16_train.py --save_at 0.25,0.5,0.75 (writes <name>_p25 / _p50 / _p75 run dirs with model.pt and a config card); seeds 0 / 1 are NOT replayable because the stored runs wrote model.pt only at the end

c.recipe: j1eq 50 % checkpoints of the four E240 runs, same evaluation
c.note: seeds 2 / 3 carry the checkpoints; seeds 0 / 1 of both arms are re-run only if the budget allows (they would add two more pairings for 0.45 GPU h)

rule.note: at 50 % of the budget, j1rc is at least 0.02 above j1eq in every pairing
guard: the final Q winner is not cut; Q itself is NOT expected to separate at 50 %

kill: stop if the first 50 % checkpoint of a run already differs from its final model by a missing key or a shape error, or if VAL250 of the 50 % checkpoint is NaN; if E240 is not launched with --save_at there is nothing to replay and this card is void (it does not add training runs of its own)
